prompt: Which correctly loads an image from the classpath and draws it at (0,0)?
choices: Image img = new File("/logo.png"); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0, this);
ImageIcon icon = new ImageIcon("/logo.png"); g.drawImage(icon, 0, 0, this);
explanation: getClass().getResource("/logo.png") loads from the classpath (works inside JARs). ImageIO.read returns a BufferedImage. drawImage paints it. Option A: File is not an Image. Option C: ImageIcon can't be passed to drawImage directly. Option D: drawImage doesn't accept a String path.
